label: preparing
what: A covert surprise jubilee for the mayor: preparing 200 fresh loaves for the town hall feast tables, installing eight hall lanterns, and arranging a deceptive lighting-inspection visit at 18:00. The mayor was not told the true purpose; the record supports that he was misled about it. The neighbour was asked to keep the order private and passed only an innocuous message about finding the miller, so there is not clear evidence the neighbour knowingly helped the surprise itself.
